usedFor: Zoho Desk holds tickets, Sangam CRM holds leads, and “New Contact” in Zoho Desk can feed “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ticket” in Zoho Desk, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A ticket created in Zoho Desk becomes a lead, matched by ID, email or phone and updated.

watchOut: “Updated Ticket” and “New Comment” can fire many times per ticket, so “Create or Update Lead” can run repeatedly.
